items.headline: 让天气模型学会纠正自己的偏差
items.headline_en: Teaching weather models to correct their biases
items.summary: MIT 10月14日报道，研究团队用历史预报与实测资料，训练机器学习系统纠正现有模型的系统偏差，改善未来两至六周的温度、降水概率预报。这有助于农业和能源部门提前准备；预测的是可能性，并不意味着能准确说出六周后某天的天气。
items.summary_en: MIT reported on October 14 that researchers trained a machine-learning system on past forecasts and observations to correct systematic errors in existing models. It improved probabilistic temperature and rainfall forecasts two to six weeks ahead. Such forecasts could give farmers and energy planners more preparation time. They describe likelihoods, however, rather than guaranteeing the weather on a particular day six weeks away.

source.name: 麻省理工学院 / MIT News

items.headline: 找新材料，AI也需要理解三维结构
items.headline_en: Finding materials requires seeing their 3D structure
items.summary: MIT 10月18日报道，研究者把晶体的三维原子排列与文字描述结合训练AI。相比只读论文文字，模型更能把结构与性能联系起来，并筛出有潜力的固态电池电解质候选。关键不只是有哪些元素，还有原子怎样排列；计算筛选仍不等于材料已经通过实验。
items.summary_en: MIT reported on October 18 that researchers combined three-dimensional crystal structures with written descriptions to train an AI model. Compared with text-only training, it better connected structure with properties and identified promising solid-state battery electrolyte candidates. A material depends not only on which elements it contains, but also on how its atoms are arranged. Computational screening does not by itself establish experimental performance.

source.name: 麻省理工学院 / MIT News

items.headline: 经历过疫情的猕猴，更警惕污染线索
items.headline_en: Outbreak-exposed macaques were warier of food
items.summary: 加州大学圣迭戈分校10月20日报道，55只猕猴的选择实验发现，经历病毒暴发的群体较少取食带粪便视觉线索的食物，即使个体未感染也如此。粪便被封在透明树脂下，测试无感染风险。这提示经历可能塑造避病行为；群体比较不能证明猕猴懂得传播机制。
items.summary_en: UC San Diego reported on October 20 that tests of 55 macaques found outbreak-exposed groups less willing to take food with visual faecal cues, including individuals never infected. The faeces were sealed beneath clear resin, removing infection risk. Experience may shape pathogen avoidance, but comparisons between groups do not establish that monkeys understand disease transmission.

source.name: 加州大学圣迭戈分校 / UC San Diego

items.headline: 湿组织难黏合，先吸走表面水
items.headline_en: Absorbing surface water helps tissue adhesives stick
items.summary: MIT 10月20日介绍源自实验室的组织黏合技术：早期双面胶用聚丙烯酸吸走表面水，数秒内贴住湿组织，有望减少缝合造成的损伤与渗漏。相关手术修复用途计划2027年进入人体试验；原理可行并不等于所有手术已证实安全有效。
items.summary_en: MIT reported on October 20 on tissue adhesives developed from laboratory research. Early double-sided versions used polyacrylic acid to absorb surface water and attach to wet tissue within seconds, potentially reducing damage and leaks associated with stitching. Human trials for surgical repair applications are planned for 2027; a working principle does not establish safety and effectiveness for every operation.

source.name: 麻省理工学院 / MIT News

items.headline: 干旱遇上人为点火，风险如何叠加？
items.headline_en: How drought and human ignition combine to raise fire risk
items.summary: NASA 10月22日报道，9—10月新几内亚遭遇干旱与大范围火灾。厄尔尼诺改变降雨，使植被易燃；农事、清地等人为点火更容易失控。卫星影像和排放模型帮助追踪烟尘与碳释放，显示气候和土地利用会叠加风险；排放量属于模型估算，并非逐处直接测量。
items.summary_en: NASA reported on October 22 that drought and widespread fires affected New Guinea in September and October. El Niño shifted rainfall, drying vegetation so agricultural and land-clearing fires could spread uncontrolled. Satellite images and emissions models track smoke and carbon release, showing how climate and land use combine to raise risk. Emissions are modelled estimates, not direct measurements of every fire.

source.name: 美国航天局地球观测站 / NASA Earth Observatory

items.headline: 火星没有GPS，毅力号怎样认路？
items.headline_en: How does Perseverance navigate Mars without GPS?
items.summary: NASA 10月21日发布的任务日志记载，毅力号10月11日累计行驶45.22公里。它把地面影像与轨道照片匹配，在没有GPS的火星定位；改进打滑模型和路径规则，让长途自主驾驶更可靠。里程服务于取样与岩石研究，并非越快越好；地形和辐射仍限制行动。
items.summary_en: A NASA mission update published on October 21 records Perseverance reaching 45.22 kilometres on October 11. Matching ground images with orbital pictures locates the rover without GPS; improved slip models and driving rules support longer autonomous drives. Distance serves sampling and rock studies, so speed alone is not the goal. Terrain and radiation still constrain operations.

source.name: 美国航天局火星任务团队 / NASA Mars Mission Team

previous_answers.headline: 把1至9各用一次，排在一个圆周上。每三个相邻位置的数相加，共得到九个和。这九个和中的最大值，最小能是多少？先试排，再证明你的答案最优。
previous_answers.headline_en: Arrange 1–9 around a circle, using each number once. Add each group of three consecutive numbers to obtain nine sums. What is the smallest possible value of the largest sum? Experiment, then prove your answer is optimal.
previous_answers.explanation: 九个和合计135，平均15。若最大值≤15，则全为15；相邻两和相减会使相隔三位的数相同，矛盾。因此至少16。圆周排列1、5、8、2、6、7、3、4、9的九个和都不超过16，达到下界。
previous_answers.explanation_en: The nine sums total 135, averaging 15. A maximum of 15 would make all sums equal; subtracting neighbouring sums would force entries three places apart to match. Thus the integer maximum is at least 16. The circular order 1,5,8,2,6,7,3,4,9 attains 16.
previous_answers.subject: W42 · 圆周极值解答

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 两枚公平六面骰子独立掷出，已知点数不同。只看第一枚，决定保留第二枚或独立重掷第二枚一次；决定前不看第二枚，重掷后必须用新点数，可与第一枚相同。最终点数和至少为8算赢。求最优策略与最大胜率。
previous_answers.headline_en: Two fair six-sided dice are rolled independently; their results are known to differ. Seeing only the first, choose to keep the hidden second die or reroll it once independently. You must accept the new result, even if it equals the first. A final sum of at least 8 wins. Find the optimal strategy and maximum win probability.
previous_answers.explanation: 第一枚仍均匀分布。保留时第二枚有5种可能，重掷后有6种。第一枚为2或3时保留，为4、5或6时重掷，为1时任选。最优胜率为(0＋1/5＋2/5＋1/2＋2/3＋5/6)/6＝13/30。
previous_answers.explanation_en: The first die is still uniform. Keeping leaves five possible hidden values; rerolling gives six. Keep for first-die values 2 or 3; reroll for 4, 5 or 6; either for 1. The optimal probability is (0+1/5+2/5+1/2+2/3+5/6)/6=13/30.
previous_answers.subject: W42 · 条件概率决策解答

previous_answers.headline: 六个点两两相连，每条连线涂红或蓝。三条边同色的三角形，最少能有几个？请证明下界，并画出达到下界的涂色方案。挑战：能否让红色、蓝色三角形各恰好一个？
previous_answers.headline_en: Join every pair of six points, colouring each edge red or blue. What is the minimum number of triangles with all three edges the same colour? Prove a lower bound and draw a colouring that attains it. Bonus: can there be exactly one red triangle and one blue triangle?
previous_answers.result_en: Minimum: 2; one of each colour is possible
previous_answers.explanation: 每点有d条红边，则一红一蓝的边对有d(5−d)≤6个。每个非同色三角形被数两次，故至多18个；20个三角形中至少2个同色。点标为1至6，红边取12、15、16、24、26、34、35，其余为蓝：仅红126、蓝456同色。
previous_answers.explanation_en: A vertex with d red edges has d(5−d)≤6 mixed-colour edge pairs. Each non-monochromatic triangle contributes two pairs, so at most 18 of 20 triangles are non-monochromatic. Label the points 1–6. Colour edges 12,15,16,24,26,34,35 red and all others blue: only red 126 and blue 456 are monochromatic.
previous_answers.subject: W42 · 组合计数证明解答

challenges.headline: 5×5方格起初全白。每步可选一整行或一整列，把其中所有格子黑白互换。若最终至少有一个黑格，黑格最少能有几个？给出做法，并证明不能更少。
challenges.headline_en: A 5×5 grid starts entirely white. Each move flips every cell in one whole row or column between black and white. If at least one cell ends black, what is the smallest possible number of black cells? Give a construction and prove it is minimal.

challenges.headline_en: Keep tossing a fair coin independently until HHT or HTH first appears as three consecutive results (H=heads, T=tails). Which pattern is more likely to appear first? Find its probability and justify your answer.

challenges.headline_en: Choose distinct integers from 1 to 60. Your set must not contain a<b<c with b a multiple of a and c a multiple of b. What is the largest possible number of selected integers? Give an example and prove optimality.
